pdf.zh: 创建、阅读和审阅 PDF，提取文字、检查分页与版式，并验证渲染效果。
pdf.en: Create, read and review PDFs; extract text and verify pagination, layout and rendering.

gh-fix-ci.zh: 检查 GitHub Actions 的失败任务和日志，定位 CI 问题，并在授权范围内修复验证。
gh-fix-ci.en: Inspect failed GitHub Actions jobs and logs, diagnose CI problems and verify authorized fixes.

skill-creator.zh: 创建或改进 Skill，组织说明、工作流程、脚本和参考资料，扩展智能体能力。
skill-creator.en: Create or improve Skills with clear instructions, workflows, scripts and reference material.

humanizer.zh: 改写生硬或模板化的文字，减少机器腔，保留原意并呈现自然、具体的表达。
humanizer.en: Rewrite stiff or formulaic text into natural, specific language while preserving its meaning.

grounded-citations.zh: 为回答和文档查找可核验的来源，让论断、引用和证据对应，减少无依据的表述。
grounded-citations.en: Ground answers and documents in verifiable sources, with citations that support each claim.

systematic-debugging.zh: 通过复现、收集证据、验证假设和回归测试，系统定位根因，再实施修复。
systematic-debugging.en: Reproduce problems, gather evidence, test hypotheses and verify the root cause before fixing bugs.

microsoft-office.zh: 创建、阅读和编辑 Word 文档、PowerPoint 演示文稿与 Excel 表格。
microsoft-office.en: Create, read and edit Word documents, PowerPoint presentations and Excel spreadsheets.

dogfood.zh: 对网页应用开展探索测试，复现问题、收集截图和证据，并整理可执行的问题报告。
dogfood.en: Explore and test web apps, reproduce bugs, collect evidence and produce actionable issue reports.

archify.zh: 将需求或现有系统整理为可交互的架构图、流程图、时序图和状态图，支持主题切换与导出。
archify.en: Turn requirements or existing systems into interactive architecture, workflow, sequence and state diagrams with themes and export.
